description:
FULL PLANNING APPLICATION FOR ROOF ALTERATIONS
INCLUDING THE PROVISION OF 4 NO. NEW MECHANICAL VENTILATION INTAKE AND
DISCHARGE COWLS IN CONNECTION WITH THE FIT-OUT OF THE PREMISES FOR USE AS A
COMMERCIAL KITCHEN AND CHANGE OF USE OF THE EXISTING UNIT TO A CLASS B2 UNIT.
decision_conditions: <p>Flexible couplings and mountings are to be used between the ductwork and the walls so there is no transmission of vibration.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of the occupiers in the local vicinity.</p>

<p>Noise levels expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) LAeq (60 minutes), from any new plant/machinery installation shall not exceed LA90-5dB at the boundary with the any residential property and mitigation measures shall at least meet those or higher contained within the NoiseAir Limited dated 14th January 2026 report reference P9368-R1-V1.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of the occupiers in the local vicinity.</p>

<p>Appropriate odour abatement measures specific to this development will therefore be recommended within the NoiseAir Limited P9368-R2- V2 Dated 13 February 2026 report Odour from the new extraction and odour control unit shall be designed and installed so that cooking odour is not detectable to affect other premises.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of the occupiers in the local vicinity.</p>
